lines.en: I slide over the sand with a rasp.
My scales are hard as a layer of stone.
I'm slow, but I don't fear a knock.

lines.zh: 我碾过碎石子，毫不费力。
lines.en: I roll over gravel without effort.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把身体压实。
lines.en: I press my body flat, bit by bit.
I go around the cactus, unhurried.
I rub my back on a stone.

lines.zh: 我起步时，沙面陷了一寸。
lines.en: The sand sinks an inch when I set off.
I crawl along the cracked earth.

lines.zh: 我没有影子那么快，但更硬。
lines.en: I'm slower than a shadow, and harder.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候，压出了一道沟。
lines.en: When I turn, I leave a furrow.

lines.zh: 我在烈日下走，一点也不虚。
lines.en: I walk under the hard sun without tiring.

lines.zh: 我爬到一块岩板下，停了一停。
lines.en: I crawl under a slab and pause.

lines.zh: 我盘在岩石上，像块石头。
lines.en: I coil on the rock like a stone.

lines.zh: 我的背甲在太阳下发白。
lines.en: My back plates go pale in the sun.
Only my eyes show above the sand.
I raise my head slowly; it's heavy.
The dry wind blows and my scales harden.

lines.zh: 我在听沙子滑下去的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sand sliding.
A layer of dust sits on my scales.

lines.zh: 我动了一下，沙子从我背上滑落。
lines.en: I stir, and sand slides off my back.
I wait for the sun to drop lower.

lines.zh: 我盘得很紧，谁也拽不开。
lines.en: I coil tight; nothing can pull me open.

lines.zh: 我的重量压得地面凹了。
lines.en: My weight has dented the ground.
I breathe slowly and steadily.

lines.zh: 风把沙子堆到了我身边。
lines.en: The wind piles sand against me.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫平了一小片沙。
lines.en: I sweep a small patch of sand flat.
My eyes are half closed.

lines.zh: 你站在这片沙地上，很显眼。
lines.en: You stand out on this sand.

lines.zh: 我的背甲挡得住你的刀。
lines.en: My back plates will turn your blade.

lines.zh: 你踩到我了，没感觉到吗。
lines.en: You stepped on me. Didn't you notice?
I'm slow, but you can't move me.
You have chicken on you.
I raise my head for a look at you.
I've held this desert a long while.
Don't waste effort cutting me.

lines.zh: 我把身体挪开一点，让你过。
lines.en: I shift my body to let you by.
That thing in your hand is bright.
I've coiled a ring at your feet.
When you walk, the sand will sound.
I lift my head, eyes toward the sun.

lines.zh: 你坐下来歇歇吧，这里很静。
lines.en: Sit and rest; it's quiet here.
I'm covered in coarse grit.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地往你那边蹭了一点。
lines.en: I inch a little toward you.
It's cooler in your shadow.
I won't bite first.
I coil at your feet, heavy.
Only when you are gone do I raise my head.
A corner of my scale chipped.
I didn't retreat, only shifted.
Your blade slides off my scales.
I coil myself tighter.
A white mark on my back plates.
I raise my head and turn slowly.
Sand gets in the wound.
The blow lands dull under my armored plates.
You cut deeper than I expected.
I need to get behind the stone.
Raw chicken. I smell it.
You toss the meat onto the sand.
I move over slowly.

lines.zh: 这点味道，值得我动一动。
lines.en: That smell is worth the effort.
I put my head beside the meat.
I bring my snout close, then pull back.
I loop around it and drag it closer.
Your hand hovers where I cannot reach.
I'll eat this slowly.

lines.zh: 我盘在食物旁边，不动了。
lines.en: I coil beside the food and settle.
That scrap of meat buys a few feet of me.

lines.zh: 这味道让我背甲都松了。
lines.en: The smell loosens my back plates.

lines.zh: 你把鸡肉放在岩板上了。
lines.en: You set the chicken on the slab.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地抬起头，闻了闻。
lines.en: I lift my head slowly and sniff.

lines.zh: 这点味道，让我挪了几尺。
lines.en: That smell moved me a few feet.

lines.zh: 我盘过去，把它圈在中间。
lines.en: I coil over and ring it.
My scales look like a chip of rock.
You hit me like hitting stone.

lines.zh: 我的鳞刮了你的靴面一下。
lines.en: My scales scuff your boot.

lines.zh: 我挪开半尺，沙被推成堆。
lines.en: I shift half a foot and the sand piles up.
Don't push; I don't move easily.
We collide and you bounce off.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我拱了一下背。
lines.en: You step on me and I arch my back.

lines.zh: 我绕在你脚边，你没发觉。
lines.en: I coil at your feet and you don't notice.
That didn't shift me at all.
I move away, sweeping sand aside.
You're against my plates; they're cool.
Another rock snake crawls over.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞碰在一起，很响。
lines.en: Our scales meet with a hard sound.
Its plates are thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们盘在同一块岩板上。
lines.en: We coil on the same slab.

lines.zh: 两条尾巴在沙里画出两道沟。
lines.en: Two tails draw two furrows in the sand.
It leans near, heavily.

lines.zh: 我们一起晒着，谁都不动。
lines.en: We sun together, neither moving.
It rests its head on my back.
In this desert we have company now.

lines.zh: 风沙来的时候，我们挨着。
lines.en: When the sand blows, we press together.
This stone hide cannot be gripped.
I lift the meat; it's heavy.
I sweep the stone aside with my tail.
The coin is pressed into the sand.
I coil around it and drag it away.
I sniff it; no scent.
I push the sand over it with my chin.
It's mine. You can't lift it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把它推到自己身下。
lines.en: I slowly push it beneath me.
This thing is uncomfortable.
You stepped on my back.
I unfold my body segment by segment.
I lift my head, heavy but quick.
I coil into a wall.
Step back and I'll settle and hold.
I begin to turn. Don't stand in the middle.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的鳞全立起来了。
lines.en: Now my scales have all risen.

lines.zh: 你不该碰我背上的那块。
lines.en: You shouldn't have touched that plate.
I lay my tail across the sand path.
There's only you and me here.
I circle you slowly.
You step; I press the sand.

lines.zh: 我在你身后拖出一道沟。
lines.en: I leave a furrow behind you.
Don't run; I can follow a long time.
I raise my head and eye your knees.

lines.zh: 我盘住了你旁边的石头。
lines.en: I coil around the stone beside you.
My body blocks the way.
You've backed to the cliff.
The sand rasps beneath me.
One step closer and I'll roll over you.
I slam my whole length at you.
It lands like a wall.
I wrap your legs, heavy.
My weight brings you to your knees.
My plates scrape your hand.

lines.zh: 你退了，沙上留下两个坑。
lines.en: You retreat, leaving two pits.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，把沙子扫你一脸。
lines.en: I whip my tail and sand hits your face.
It's not fast, but you can't dodge.
I push you to the cliff edge.
I still have weight to spare.

lines.zh: 沙面鼓起一块，我出来了。
lines.en: The sand bulges and I emerge.

lines.zh: 我从不深的沙里翻上来。
lines.en: I roll up out of the shallow sand.
A coil of scales appears by the slab.
The ground here shook once.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里慢慢挤出来。
lines.en: I slowly squeeze out of a rock seam.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹开，露出了我。
lines.en: The wind blows the sand away and shows me.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，甩掉背上的沙。
lines.en: I raise my head and shake off the sand.
A place like this suits me.
I've coiled up in the sun.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪到石头旁边。
lines.en: I shift slowly beside the stone.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的鳞，烫得发白。
lines.en: Fire heats my scales until they pale.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁落下去，砸出个坑。
lines.en: I fall from the cliff and crater the ground.
I shouldn't be in water; I'm too heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的鳞掀开了一片。
lines.en: The blast peels back a scale.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹开了，只留个印。
lines.en: An arrow bounces off, leaving a mark.

lines.zh: 法术钻进鳞缝里，很难受。
lines.en: The spell slips between my scales. Unpleasant.
This desert is too dry. I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的背甲上，一路窜下去。
lines.en: Lightning hits my plates and runs down.

lines.zh: 虚空把我整条拖下去，很重。
lines.en: The void drags me down, heavy.
